title: Tape fold on a finite prefix
statement: Let $Q,T$ be types, let $f:\mathbb{N}\to\operatorname{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$, and let $p,r$ be natural numbers. Folding the first $r$ record symbols, with symbol $j$ containing $f(j)$ and a mark exactly when $p=j$, from the initial summary $(\mathrm{false},\mathrm{none},\mathrm{false},\mathrm{false})$ yields $( [0<r],\, f(p)\text{ if }p<r\text{ and none otherwise},\, [0<r\text{ and }p=0],\, [0<r\text{ and }p+1=r])$, where each bracket denotes the Boolean truth value of the stated condition.
hypotheses_covered: Function f from natural numbers to optional Booleans
